risks.note: Most revenues are derived from a few large US and UK-based clients, so any economic slowdown or downturn in these economies and industries may affect the business. Healthcare services are less prone to recessionary cycles, but the customer-management business is relatively low-margin and more prone to economic variation, and technology disruption could cause volume shrinkage. Mitigated by building differentiated, productised digital services anchored by Intelligence That Operates and Kairos to retain and grow wallet share and win new logos.

Operations span India, the US, the UK, the Philippines, Mexico, South Africa, Australia, Dubai (UAE) and Egypt, exposing the Company to geopolitical and regulatory risks beyond its control. The proposed US HIRE Act, which contemplates a 25% tax on payments made by US companies to foreign service providers including Indian IT and BPO companies, is flagged as a legislative risk to monitor, alongside US-India trade tensions spilling into services. Mitigated by local management teams and a well-diversified geographic spread.
risks.risk: Country, geopolitical and legislative risk - including the proposed US HIRE Act

risks.note: Competitors include third-party pure-play BPS providers in India and the Philippines, local/onshore providers in the US and UK, BPS divisions of global IT companies, and in-house captives of potential clients. The Company counters through investment in domain expertise, digital capabilities, process excellence, operational rigour and the Kairos-anchored transformation framework to enable non-linear growth in revenues and margins.
Client contracts run between one and ten years, and after a term expires contracts are typically re-tendered through a procurement process; non-renewal may significantly affect revenues.

The BPS selling cycle ranges from months to multiple years and requires significant capital, resources and time from both clients and the Company, delaying revenue conversion. Mitigated by marketing, sales and business-development teams across geographies and an aggressive transition methodology that moves new wins quickly into service delivery.

Exchange rates have been volatile and operating results will continue to be impacted; the Indian rupee steadily weakened against the US dollar over 2025, depreciating by approximately 4-5%. A weaker rupee initially boosts revenue realisations, but prolonged instability could raise import costs for IT-related infrastructure. Mitigated by a dedicated treasury function and an internal FX risk management policy that hedges net exposures through forward cover contracts and other suitable products.
risks.risk: Currency volatility (INR vs USD and GBP)

risks.note: Possible inability to collect from clients or delays in collection, with pressure persisting from liquidity situations at certain clients, could affect cash receivables and require temporary enhancement of short-term credit lines. The Company also operates through legal entities in multiple countries subject to differing accounting standards and uses financial leverage, making timely borrowing, repayment and cost of funds important; mitigated by a well-defined governance mechanism and a robust internal financial controls framework.
risks.risk: Customer credit, liquidity and solvency risk

risks.note: Identified in the BRSR as both a risk and an opportunity - cyberattacks and data-breach incidents threaten data safety, privacy and reputational standing, with potential fines for non-compliance. Mitigated through ISO 27001 certified operation centers with processes certified under HIPAA, HITRUST and SOC2, regular audits with a zero-tolerance policy, secure VPN with two-factor authentication, EDR/DLP/encryption/DNS-layer security and secure mail gateway, third-party vulnerability and penetration testing, PCI DSS compliance scans, source-code and cloud reviews, and 24x7x365 monitoring via MDR services.
